title: Titan Pro 15K Cherry Fizz Prefilled Pod + Refills
description: Cherry Fizz captures the sweetness of ripe Cherry with a playful soda twist that adds a light effervescence to each puff. The result is a bright, fruity vape that balances sweetness with refreshment. Each Titan Pro 15K Prefilled Pod pack includes a 2ml pod and 10ml refill container, designed to work perfectly with the Titan Pro 15K device. The mesh coil ensures consistent vapour and flavour clarity, while the refill system keeps the coil saturated for extended use How To Set Up Titan Pro 15K Pods Step 1 Insert the prefilled pod into the Titan Pro 15K device until it clicks. Step 2 Fit the 10ml refill container securely into the base compartment. Step 3 Inhale on the mouthpiece to vape. Replace both when empty. ✅ You're all set!
